# case mutated_exports_grow_then_clear CheckNoMutatedEs6Exports
## file grow.js
export let zeta = 0, alpha = 0, mu = 0, Aa = 0, BB = 0, q = 0, b = 0, a = 0, c = 0, longer_name = 0;
export let x1 = 0, x2 = 0, x3 = 0, x4 = 0, x5 = 0, x6 = 0, x7 = 0, x8 = 0, x9 = 0, x10 = 0;
let notExported = 0;
export function mutate() {
  zeta++; alpha++; mu++; Aa++; BB++; q++; b++; a++; c++; longer_name++;
  x1++; x2++; x3++; x4++; x5++; x6++; x7++; x8++; x9++; x10++;
  notExported++;
}
